verdict.rationale: Ellis Porter documents a secure online portal where clients and attorneys upload and review documents together, communicate in one place instead of scattered emails, and track case status. This covers the core of replacing email attachments. However, this rests on a single first-party mention, and the structured-workflow elements of the story are not evidenced. Missing for 10: document checklists, automated reminders, details of portal workflow structure, independent or hands-on corroboration.
